learnings: Always pass `encoding='utf-8'` and use `with` so files are closed even on errors.
Write every line with a trailing newline so appends never glue lines together.
Atomic writes (temp file + `os.replace`) protect data against crashes.
pitfalls: Writing without a newline and then appending produced `firstsecond` – a real data bug.
next: Stream huge files line by line on Day 90.
